# Count unique players per nationality
unique_players_per_nationality = df.groupby('nationality')['player'].nunique()
# Find the nationality with the maximum count
max_count = unique_players_per_nationality.max()
# Check if England has the maximum count and if it's strictly greater than all others
england_count = unique_players_per_nationality.get('england', 0)
# Determine if England contributed the most players (i.e., has the highest count and it's unique)
answer = (england_count == max_count) and (unique_players_per_nationality == max_count).sum() == 1
